name: javascript-tests-for
about: A node:test file (solution.test.mjs) for your module that passes on it and catches at least min_killed of its mutants.
instructions: Return only the node:test file. It imports from './solution.mjs'. Test the edges: boundaries, empty input, both sides of every condition.

code.about: the module to test, correct as it is

min_killed.about: share of mutants the tests must catch (0..1); some mutants can't be caught by any input, so 1.0 is rarely right
